tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the live web and return ranked results with a title, direct URL, and snippet. Use for current information, recent events, recommendations, technical answers, documentation links, and other topics requiring internet knowledge. Supports search operators such as site:example.com, quoted phrases, -word exclusions, and filetype:pdf.

query.description: The search query, e.g. 'rust async vs threads performance'

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5, min: 1, max: 10)
